text:
If you were hoping the rain would clear out by sunset, no such luck tonight — showers and a rumble of thunder are still popping through, and that pattern just keeps rolling overnight into a low around 62. The lake's calm under it, winds light and variable, waves a foot or less, so it's more soggy than rough out there if you're near the water. Skies stay mostly cloudy, humidity holding around 65%.

Thursday looks like a repeat performance: scattered showers and thunderstorms move through both morning and afternoon as another disturbance slides by, with a high near 78. NWS and the Euro don't fully agree on how wet it gets, the Euro's leaning much soggier than the American models, so I'd keep the rain gear handy all day rather than betting on a dry window. Air quality's a non-issue, good and clean. The real payoff is Friday and into the weekend, when the AFD has things drying out and turning genuinely pleasant, so hang in there through one more damp day.

Sunshine returns and warms up nicely, high near 82, trending dry and pleasant.
